name: Phoenix VII
description:
Phoenix VII is a family-friendly beachfront condo in Orange Beach, Alabama, offering 450 feet of direct Gulf frontage on the area’s famous sugar-white sand. This 15-story, steel-and-concrete tower features 247 Gulf-front condos, all designed to face the water and provide uninterrupted views of the Gulf throughout the year.
